name: Featured collection
steps: Open Online Store > Themes > Customize for an unpublished copy. Choose the page template, select Add section, and choose Featured collection.
Select Add block inside this section. Use the supported block types listed below, then drag them into the desired reading order.
Connect your own content and media before adjusting layout, typography, color, and spacing. Section overrides take priority where the section offers them.
Preview desktop and mobile, test any links or controls, and save. Publish only after reviewing the complete customer journey.

settings.label: Layout mode
settings.how: Choose one of the supported options below for layout mode. Only the selected option applies; other settings can further customize its appearance.

settings.label: Entrance animation
settings.how: Choose one of the supported options below for entrance animation. Only the selected option applies; other settings can further customize its appearance.

settings.label: Show section header
settings.how: Turn on “Show section header” to apply that behavior. Turn it off to remove that behavior. Other settings can affect whether the result is visible; check the section preview after changing it.
